books.title: The Four Noble Truths
books.author: Ajahn Sumedho
books.description: This book came with me on an e-reader during a trip to Thailand, when I was looking for a way through the monkey mind that had held me in a chokehold for much of my life, perhaps all of it. Together with my experience at my first Goenka retreat in Suriname, it gave me faith that this path could genuinely lead to the lessening, and perhaps eventually the overcoming, of suffering.

books.title: Bodhinyana
books.author: Ajahn Chah
books.description: This book came with me when I visited Suddhavari Monastery in Brazil. Staying at a monastery in Ajahn Chah's lineage, I felt deeply grateful for another opportunity to deepen the practice. My time there taught me a great deal about practising mindfulness during ordinary duties, and this book became part of that experience.

books.title: Practical Insight Meditation: Basic and Progressive Stages
books.author: Mahāsi Sayādaw
books.description: Ajahn Tong's approach belongs to the wider Mahāsi tradition. This short text helped me see more clearly the lineage behind the meditation instructions I had received. It sits alongside the books in [Meditation & Practice](#meditation-practice).

books.title: The Four Noble Truths
books.author: Ajahn Sumedho
books.description: A brief orientation to the central framework.
books.meta: Free · Abhayagiri Monastery · [why I return to it](#return-four-noble-truths)

books.title: Mindfulness in Plain English
books.author: Bhante Henepola Gunaratana
books.description: Practical meditation instruction in accessible language.

books.title: The Art of Living: Peace and Freedom in the Here and Now
books.author: Thich Nhat Hanh
books.description: A gentler treatment of awareness in ordinary life. Thich Nhat Hanh writes from the Zen tradition rather than the Theravada teachers above, so the register is different. It is also the one book in this sequence you have to buy.

books.title: The Only Way: Path to Nibbana
books.author: Ajahn Tong Sirimangalo
books.description: Since visiting Wat Chom Tong Vipassana Meditation Center in 2023, these instructions have stayed with me in daily practice. The book has since been revised and republished, but the words I encountered then still remain with me.
books.meta: Wat Chom Tong · no edition online; usually given at the monastery

books.title: On Meditation
books.author: Ajahn Chah
books.description: Although the formal teachings I receive come through Ajahn Tong's lineage, I am also deeply moved by Ajahn Chah's lineage. The manner of teaching is different, and I feel fortunate that both have crossed my path.

books.title: Mindfulness: The Path to the Deathless
books.author: Ajahn Sumedho
books.description: Instructions on awareness in posture, feeling, and daily activity.

books.title: The Heart of Buddhist Meditation
books.author: Nyanaponika Thera
books.description: A study of satipaṭṭhāna, first published by the Buddhist Publication Society.

books.title: In This Very Life
books.author: Sayādaw U Paṇḍita
books.description: Another teacher in the Mahāsi lineage, Sayādaw U Paṇḍita helped me understand more clearly what sustained vipassanā practice can look like in daily life.

books.title: A Householder's Vinaya
books.author: Allan Cooper
books.description: Allan Cooper wrote the kind of book I had been looking for. After a retreat, I can quickly fall back into old habits. This book offers practical tools for carrying a measure of ethics, concentration and wisdom back into life at home.

books.title: Gold Wrapped in Rags
books.author: Ajaan Jia Cundo, translated by Ajaan Dick Sīlaratano
books.description: The autobiography of a forest monk who trained under Ajaan Mun and practiced alongside Ajaan Mahā Boowa, told in his own words.

books.title: Venerable Ācariya Mun Bhūridatta Thera
books.author: Ajaan Mahā Boowa Ñāṇasampanno, translated by Ajaan Dick Sīlaratano
books.description: Ajaan Mahā Boowa's account of his own teacher, Ajaan Mun, a central figure of the modern Thai Forest Tradition.

books.title: Samana
books.author: Ajaan Mahā Boowa Ñāṇasampanno, edited by Ajaan Dick Sīlaratano
books.description: A short account of Ajaan Mahā Boowa's final days and passing, written for those who practiced with him.

books.title: Uncommon Wisdom
books.author: Ajaan Dick Sīlaratano
books.description: The life of Ajaan Paññāvaḍḍho, an English-born monk who trained for decades under Ajaan Mahā Boowa in the northeastern Thai forest tradition.

books.title: Mae Chee Kaew
books.author: Ajaan Dick Sīlaratano
books.description: The life of a laywoman turned nun in rural northeastern Thailand who studied under several of the era's best-known meditation teachers.

books.title: Everything Is Teaching Us
books.author: Ajahn Chah, translated by Paul Breiter
books.description: Talks on meeting ordinary situations, irritation, boredom, doubt, as material for practice rather than obstacles to it.

books.title: Food for the Heart
books.author: Ajahn Chah
books.description: A substantial collection of Ajahn Chah's talks, gathered for readers coming to his teaching for the first time.

books.title: A Taste of Freedom
books.author: Ajahn Chah
books.description: A short collection of talks originally given to Western monks training in Ajahn Chah's monasteries.

books.title: Bodhinyana
books.author: Ajahn Chah
books.description: A collection of Dhamma talks given to monks at Wat Pah Pong, on the discipline and attitude that make practice possible.
books.meta: Free · Forest Sangha · [why I return to it](#return-bodhinyana)

books.title: The Way It Is
books.author: Ajahn Sumedho
books.description: Talks on meditation and the nature of mind, from one of Ajahn Chah's first Western disciples.

books.title: Intuitive Awareness
books.author: Ajahn Sumedho
books.description: Talks on recognizing awareness itself, rather than its changing contents.

books.title: Now Is the Knowing
books.author: Ajahn Sumedho
books.description: A collection of short talks on present-moment awareness.

books.title: Arahattamagga Arahattaphala: The Path to Arahantship
books.author: Ajaan Mahā Boowa Ñāṇasampanno
books.description: Ajaan Mahā Boowa's account of the path and its fruition, drawn from talks given late in his teaching life.

books.title: Things as They Are
books.author: Ajaan Mahā Boowa Ñāṇasampanno
books.description: A collection of Dhamma talks given to monks in training at Wat Pa Baan Taad.

books.title: Forest Desanās
books.author: Ajaan Mahā Boowa Ñāṇasampanno
books.description: Short talks translated from Thai, given informally to the monastic community.

books.title: Seeking Buddho
books.author: Ajahn Anan Akiñcano
books.description: Reflections on meditation practice and the search for a teacher, from the Thai forest tradition.

books.title: In the Buddha's Words
books.author: Edited and introduced by Bhikkhu Bodhi
books.description: A thematic anthology of discourses from the Pāli Canon.

books.title: The Middle Length Discourses of the Buddha
books.author: Majjhima Nikāya, translated by Bhikkhu Ñāṇamoli and Bhikkhu Bodhi
books.description: A complete translation of the Majjhima Nikāya.

books.title: The Connected Discourses of the Buddha
books.author: Saṁyutta Nikāya, translated by Bhikkhu Bodhi
books.description: A complete translation of the Saṁyutta Nikāya.

books.title: The Worn-out Skin

books.description: A translation of the Uraga Sutta with a short modern reflection on shedding attachment.
